nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of each account.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spending allowances.
Public string token name initialized to BAZAN__20230515.
Public string token symbol initialized to BAZANI.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total token supply, fixed at deployment value.
Constructor that mints the entire totalSupply to the deployer (msg.sender) and emits Transfer.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) setting the allowance of msg.sender for a spender.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) moving tokens on behalf of an owner using allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender in this contract.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer; unchecked arithmetic written back to storage.
balanceOf[to] += value inside transfer; unchecked addition written back to storage.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value inside transferFrom; unchecked subtraction written to storage.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, attacker-influenced recipient address.
Parameter 'value' of transfer, attacker-influenced amount.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, address granted allowance.
Parameter 'value' of approve, allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, source owner of the tokens.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, destination of the tokens.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom, amount moved.
balanceOf[from] -= value inside transferFrom; unchecked subtraction written to storage.
balanceOf[to] += value inside transferFrom; unchecked addition written to storage.

Parameter 'to' selects the balance slot incremented by the transfer.
Parameter 'value' flows into the recipient balance addition.
Result of the addition is written back into the balanceOf storage mapping.

transfer() executes the recipient balance addition statement.

Result of the transferFrom source subtraction is written back to balanceOf.

Parameter 'value' flows into the recipient balance addition.

transferFrom() executes balanceOf[to] += value.

Result of the allowance decrement is written back into the allowance mapping.
